name: Scarlet Defiance: The Wall Between Us
source:
『[i]One wall, two lovers, and a prophecy that could change it all.[/i]』

In a world divided by a wall, humans and vampires live in a tense ceasefire that could break with just one wrong move. However, some still believe in the prophecy that will end the war and the animosity between the two sides once and for all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]一堵牆，兩位戀人，還有一個足以改變一切的預言。[/i]

一堵牆將世界一分為二，人類和吸血鬼勉強維持著停戰的局面，哪怕一步走錯，都有可能讓戰火重燃。儘管如此，仍有人堅信那個預言能夠一勞永逸地終結這場戰爭，化解雙方的仇恨。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2866430/]Steam[/url]］
